## Change

Describe the problem and the bounded change.

## Verification

- [ ] Added or updated positive and negative tests
- [ ] Ran the relevant focused tests
- [ ] Ran `uv run --locked --no-sync python scripts/check.py` when practical
- [ ] Updated public or operational documentation when behavior changed
- [ ] Added an ADR for atomicity, identity, replay, RLS, authorization, routing, or lease changes
- [ ] Confirmed logs/evidence contain no secrets, credentials, payloads, or response bodies

## Compatibility and risk

List public API, migration, tenant-isolation, failure-recovery, and rollout implications.
